column1: # Game profile of Factorio (Switch, update 2.0.77 = v2097152). Reaches the main menu, a new game and the tutorial on the Mac
# Wube's own engine on SDL, SDK 21.4.2. It renders with OpenGL 3.3 core through EGL (NVIDIA's driver, subsdk0, is not loaded): the host's GL layer implements it on Metal
# (dm/gfx/gl/hle_gl.m). Its shaders are the RomFS's data/core/graphics/shaders/*.vert / *.frag (GLSL 330 that SPIRV-Cross wrote from HLSL), compiled verbatim at run time:
# dm/gfx/tools/gl_shaders.py translates them offline from the RomFS, no capture needed. main also imports Vulkan and the RomFS has .metal shaders, which it does not use here

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk. subsdk0 is NVIDIA's OpenGL driver, which programs the GPU through NvRm: never loaded, the GL layer answers main's EGL imports
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory; main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# no NVN shaders: the NVN tables stay empty (gl_shaders.py writes the GL library and its table, not the profile)

column2: Factorio has no NVN shaders (its GLSL shaders go through the GL layer)
